title: Why systems change matters (to the government)
description: It’s a position I have held for some time now: The government should own responsibility for driving systems change and the process of reinventing itself when needed.  Having said that, however, public entities and public servants face certain constraints. Outside capital and civil society can help them work around these to achieve the government’s welfare goals. While they cannot substitute for government, they can play the critical role of catalysts.
